in_sanskrit.name: एकोदर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ekam meaning one and Darshanam meaning to see or to have a vision. So, Ekodar means One with God or One who has a vision of God.

in_hindi.name: एकोदर
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ekam meaning one and Darshanam meaning to see or to have a vision. So, Ekodar means One with God or One who has a vision of God.

in_tamil.name: ஐகோதர
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஐக் meaning one and தர் meaning to see or to have a vision. So, ஐகோதர் means One with God or One who has a vision of God.

in_telugu.name: ైకోదర్
in_telugu.long_meaning: ైకో meaning one and దర్శన meaning to see or to have a vision. So, ైకోదర్ means One with God or One who has a vision of God.

in_marathi.name: Ekodar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One with a weapon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekodar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who holds a weapon, symbolizing bravery and protection.

in_bengali.name: Ekodar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ One with a weapon
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ekodar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who holds a weapon, symbolizing bravery and protection.
